title: [DEV] Crash loop when xDrip battery status of G6 is available in NS
symptom: AAPS comes in a crash loop, seemingly caused by battery status from xDrip in Nightscout. The stacktrace shows a NumberFormatException for input string: "6 days (voltage: 308/289)". The crash occurs after activating the NSClient plugin and pulling data from Nightscout.
cause: The crash is caused by invalid battery data in Nightscout devicestatus entries, where the battery field contains a string like "6 days (voltage: 308/289)" that AAPS tries to parse as a number, leading to a NumberFormatException. The bug originates in xDrip's NightscoutBatteryDevice code.
fix: A workaround was added to ignore devicestatus entries with invalid data. The fix was implemented in a commit and later turned into a PR. Users can also delete the devicestatus collection in MongoDB as a temporary workaround.
evidence_quote: I added a workaround in my AAPS source tree to ignore devicestatus if it contains invalid data like that.
